contact.full_name: REENA NAVIN MANE PROCESS EXCELLENCE MANAGER | LEAN SIX SIGMA BLACK BELT | PROCESS ENGINEERING & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

data.summary:
Process Excellence and Lean Six Sigma professional with 15+ years of experience across process consulting, business excellence, quality assurance, process discovery, continuous improvement and transformation. Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt with hands-on experience building LSS capability, delivering Yellow Belt and Green Belt programmes, mentoring improvement projects, facilitating practitioner communities, and applying structured problem-solving methods including DMAIC, RCA, 5 Why, FMEA, Pareto analysis and Value Stream Mapping. Experienced in stakeholder facilitation, business process modelling, analytics, automation opportunities and cross-functional transformation across global corporate and client environments.
SELECTED CAREER HIGHLIGHTS
Trained 500+ practitioners across Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt and Green Belt programmes and mentored 50+ improvement
projects through certification.
Delivered quarterly Yellow Belt and biannual Green Belt programmes across 4 corporate accounts, training 30–35
practitioners per batch.
Established and facilitated Lean Six Sigma communities and forums engaging 200+ practitioners and senior leaders. • Led regional Process Excellence CoE activities and supported global stakeholder engagement across multiple client environments.
Delivered process improvement initiatives including a 50% reduction in document delivery time, 18% reduction in reporting
errors, and automation delivering 7 FTE cost savings.
Strong exposure to process discovery, process modelling, requirements elicitation, data analysis, quality systems, process
transition and automation.
